metadata.name: Claude Code Container
metadata.description: Claude Code Container 1.0.28 runs Anthropic Claude Code in a browser terminal and an MCP API.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Anthropic API key. Leave empty to sign in with OAuth in the web terminal.

environment_variables.name: AUTH_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Password for the web terminal and bearer token for the MCP API. The catalog value is public. Replace it in the install form before the first start. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit this literal; they do not substitute Compose variables.

environment_variables.name: MCP_ENABLED
environment_variables.description: Enable the MCP endpoint. Web login still runs when this is false.

environment_variables.name: CLAUDE_SESSION_TTL
environment_variables.description: Seconds of inactivity before the web terminal session is closed.

volumes.description: Host Docker socket. Grants control of the host Docker daemon.

ports.description: Caddy web UI. ttyd stays on the Compose network. Host port 8080 is already used in this catalog.
MCP API. Host port 9090 is already used in this catalog.

before_install.en_us: Open http://localhost:20040 and sign in with the AUTH_PASSWORD you set in the install form before the first start. The catalog value is public, and this container can control the host through the Docker socket. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit that literal environment value; they do not substitute Compose variables. Caddy checks the password before it proxies to ttyd. ttyd itself is not published. The MCP API is http://localhost:20041/mcp with the same value as a bearer token. Leave ANTHROPIC_API_KEY empty to authenticate with OAuth in the terminal. OAuth state in /home/claude/.claude.json is lost when the container is recreated. Settings under /home/claude/.claude persist. Host ports 8080 and 9090 were already published, so this listing uses 20040 and 20041.
